ns2:course.label: Planning & Design Studio I
ns2:course.description: Ecological design and planning graduate studio emphasizing design that reflects evaluation and integration of human and environmental research results. Detailed investigation of design options. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. 5 graduate hours. No professional credit. Prerequisite: LA 433/434 or consent of instructor.
